content.thinking: Calibration matches the expected example. Now let me test an inconsistent profile.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
import para, numpy as np
# inconsistent: x1-x0 <= 1 and x0-x1 <= -2  -> x1-x0 >= 2 contradiction
print(para.calibrate({'groups':2,'jitter_ps':[0,0],'measurements':[[0,1,-5,1],[0,1,2,4]]}))
# feasible chain
print(para.calibrate({'groups':3,'jitter_ps':[1,1,1],'measurements':[[0,1,0,10],[1,2,0,10],[0,2,-5,25]]}))
print(para.calibrate({'groups':1,'jitter_ps':[0],'measurements':[]}))
print(para.calibrate({'groups':2,'jitter_ps':[3,0],'measurements':[[0,1,-4,-4]]}))
EOF
